target.mapping: 2 MiB at physical 0x3fe00000, frame slot 0, 640x480 indexed bytes

interpretation: The admitted MiSTer /dev/mem aperture measured approximately 94 MiB/s for the libc memcpy path; explicit scalar64 and NEON loops are slower. Removing O_SYNC did not improve the measured mapping, so the current libc copy remains the selected safe path. A 307200-byte frame consumes approximately 3.1 ms of raw copy time before CRC, ownership and DDR contention.
scope: This is an ARM/DDR bandwidth diagnostic, not a 60 FPS qualification. It does not prove cache coherency for a cached mapping or physical display/audio behavior.
